package.name: robot_control_test
package.description: Interactive web bench to verify a robot works correctly with each of its ros2_control controllers. A 3D canvas (Three.js, fed from the live URDF and TF) shows the robot's status, while the panel discovers the controllers on /controller_manager, lets you activate/deactivate them, and sends safe, speed-limited test commands: joint moves for a JointTrajectoryController, streamed joint setpoints for a forward-position controller, and Cartesian target-pose / target-wrench jogs for the FZI cartesian_motion / cartesian_compliance / cartesian_force controllers. A thin HTTP/ROS client, it imports no controller internals and degrades gracefully when a robot is absent.
